limits: Two repetitions per pool and comparative phase; no confidence interval or universal provider multiplier
Different CPU models and runner images; logical CPU count alone is not hardware equivalence
Depot checkout fell from 15 to 16 seconds cache-disabled to 3 to 4 seconds warm, before restore; whole-job difference does not isolate pnpm caching
Both warm stores reused582 packages with zero downloads according to preserved logs
No Windows or Mac warm result, fork isolation proof, monthly invoice, or full-CI graph measurement
File SHA-256 values refer to original ZIP member bytes; decoded payloads omit ephemeral cache endpoint origins

computeTimestampPriceProxy.boundary: GitHub job timestamps; includes failed and cancelled experimental jobs; does not prove allocation billing boundaries, allowance consumption, storage charges or invoices
